composition_variation: Create a stylish gouache slice-of-life portrait of Misae Nohara from Crayon Shin-chan at a quiet flower stall. Preserve her familiar brown curled hairstyle, expressive eyebrows, and warm adult appearance. She wears a mint cardigan, white blouse, relaxed beige trousers, and flat shoes. She holds one narrow wicker basket of orange tulips at waist level and looks over her shoulder with cheerful confidence. Use peach shopfronts, sage foliage, soft coral petals, and clean early morning light. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
